correctness.rationale: For W_{n+1}=K_1 join C_n with n>=3, hub-free maximality yields the whole rim. With the hub, cyclomatic excess equals e(C_n[S]); maximality forces either the two even-n alternating independent patterns or a unique selected 11 with cyclic zero runs each of length one or two. Thus n*binom(k-1,n-2k+1) counts the unique-11 sets, all bounds and n=3 boundary follow. x*d/dx of x^3(1+x)/(1-x^2-x^3) gives the rational bivariate OGF, and its simple positive dominant root gives n lambda^n/(2rho+3rho^2). The deletion support is the exact complementary set, including the gap; independent componentwise brute force confirmed every n=3..11, not asserted as an all-n proof.

value.rationale: An explicit labeled facet polynomial and complete minimal-deletion cardinality spectrum for the natural connected planar wheel family expose an unbounded hole in minimal deletion sizes, with a nontrivial rational enumeration and growth constant. This exact structural family classification is a useful benchmark for pseudoforest-deletion enumeration, not merely a textbook decision bound.
